title_block.title: BugBot Kit board (XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense daughter board)

comment.value: One board under a XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense: 4 vibration motors on one DRV8833, BNO055, ToF header, WS2812 lamp
Cell -> SW1 -> Q1 reverse-polarity FET -> VMOT (motors + the XIAO's BAT pads). 3V3 comes from the XIAO
